user.title: Connect to Guesty
user.description: Enter the client ID and client secret from your Guesty Open API application.

data_description.webhook_base_url: Only needed if Home Assistant is behind a reverse proxy - the externally reachable base URL used when registering the reservation webhook with Guesty. Leave blank to use Home Assistant's own detected external URL.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often to poll Guesty for reservation and task updates. Defaults to 15 minutes.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid client ID or client secret.

abort.already_configured: This Guesty account is already configured.

init.title: Guesty settings
init.description: Adjust the webhook base URL and how often Guesty is polled for updates.

data_description.webhook_base_url: Only needed if Home Assistant is behind a reverse proxy - override the externally reachable base URL used when registering the reservation webhook with Guesty. Leave blank to use Home Assistant's own detected external URL.
